scope: Complete 19-pair health profile after category-isolation repair; similarity is candidate evidence, not an interchangeability verdict.

pairs.reason: One operation materializes a Buffer, the other streams chunks into a supplied digest update and returns bytes consumed. Both reuse identity/limit validation and close their descriptor in finally; do not merge their materialization contracts.

Component duplication compares JSX tokens and component-only profiles. Hook extraction compares behavior tokens, includes hook profiles, and rejects mixed hook/component pairs. Both already use the shared profile and ranked-pair engine.
Framework entry-path admission and recognized framework export names are different policies (including Vite export behavior); both reuse the same path predicates.
Fingerprint metadata update propagates failures and conditionally recomputes language fingerprints; last-refresh update is best effort and cannot mask reindex success.
Unused import detection is local-binding usage; imports reporting combines compiler provenance with uncovered source bindings. Shared entry extraction/merge helpers already own common mechanics.
Full reads materialize bounded bytes; literal probes scan/hash/check encoding and materialize only matches. Both preserve descriptor identity and close in finally through common file primitives.

Dead-code augmentation credits symbol reference counts, including auxiliary/Vue/cross-language consumers. Drift augmentation constructs cross-file dependency edges and rejects unused import-only matches. They already share scanSourceReferences.
Factor shared baseline hydration plus overlay lease publication in shared-generation-store; retain missing/dirty admission, fingerprints and reason text.

The specialized dead-only scan resolves a bounded candidate-name set and releases per-file caches; the general scan uses project target IDs and its own occurrence filtering. Both share source reference scanning, while preserving their binding/coverage policies.

Object-member resolution traverses property paths and reports property-specific failures; imported-constant evaluation resolves a whole initializer with import-specific provenance. Both share evaluateNode/derivedFrom.
Primary lock reclamation holds a separate reclaim guard and rechecks liveness; reclaim-guard reclamation has its own attempt limit to avoid recursive guard acquisition.
Read verifies generation identity; persist verifies immutable content identity or writes atomically. Parsing/bounded read already shared.
Duplicate scan compares pairs by JSX overlap; pressure scan evaluates one component size/behavior and applies distinct exclusions/thresholds. Both share profiles and role policy.

Hook extraction evaluates pairs of behavior profiles; component pressure evaluates one component against line/token thresholds and excludes UI-kit files. Shared profiles do not make these the same detector.

The dead-only scan uses target-specific resolution and occurrence counts; drift records cross-file dependency edges and filters unused import evidence. Retain these distinct consumers of scanSourceReferences.

Batch document opening owns a per-call URI set. The persistent session owns openedPaths, diagnostics, readiness generations and deadlines across requests. Both skip only missing files and rethrow other read failures; do not merge the lifetimes.

Next-anchor construction returns a recoverable reference; callback enrichment mutates edge semantics after confirming result-callback behavior. Retain operations; same material-line lookup is a small possible local helper, not competing ownership.
Causal edges can be upstream or downstream; callable references require supporting behavior lines and are downstream reference evidence. Common identity/location helpers already shared.
Single-code API throws on ambiguity and returns a full file; batched code reports alternatives, missing/stale source and chosen file surfaces. Both already share source-resolution primitives.
